title: Raas Garba Festival 2026 Sat, Oct 17th - 7:30 Pm
description: Immerse in Tradition at the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026
long_description:
Immerse in Tradition at the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026
Join us on Saturday, 17th October 2026, for a night of vibrant festivities at the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026. This remarkable event, brought to you by Bay Area Youth Vaishnav Parivar (shahsaumilb), celebrates the colorful Gujarati culture, showcasing traditional Navratri/Dandiya music and dance. Be part of a pulsating rhythm that stirs the soul and captures the essence of cultural heritage.
A Night Devoid of Stars, but not of Talent
While we may not have a specific artist headlining our event, the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026 promises an evening filled with performances that resonate with the authentic Gujarati culture. Expect an array of local talents who will bring the traditional Navratri/Dandiya to life with their passionate performances and share the joy of this beautiful culture with all attendees.
Experience Cultural Bliss at Shreemaya Krishnadham Haveli
Shreemaya Krishnadham Haveli, located at 175 Nortech Parkway, San Jose, CA, is our chosen venue for this gala event. This iconic spot in the heart of United States is renowned for its welcoming atmosphere and cultural significance. The venue's strategic location ensures easy accessibility and plenty of safe parking options. For those who wish to savor Indian cuisine, numerous top-rated Indian restaurants are just a short distance away from the venue.
Secure Your Entry: Ticket Information
Do not miss out on this vibrant cultural display. Secure your tickets today. Adults can join the festivities for just $25.00, while children aged between 5 and 12 years old, as well as seniors aged 70 years and above, can enjoy the festival at a discounted rate of $20.00 per ticket. Be part of the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026 and create memories that will last a lifetime.
